entities.summary: Tehching Hsieh (b. 1950-12-31, Nanjhou Township) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nanjhou Township and Taiwan. Known in the fields of authors & novelists.
